name: Guernsey
facts: King Charles III, as Duke of Normandy

flag.description: A white field with the red cross of St George, with a smaller gold cross with flared ends laid over it.
flag.symbolism: The red cross reflects the island's ties to the English Crown, and the gold cross comes from the banner of William the Conqueror, recalling its history as part of the Duchy of Normandy.

hook: Guernsey is England's red cross with a gold cross laid on top of it, William the Conqueror riding on St George.
trivia: Before 1985 Guernsey flew a plain St George's cross; the gold cross was added to tell it apart from England's flag.
Victor Hugo wrote much of Les Misérables while in exile on Guernsey.
